wholePhysicalScope: Present hull envelope and heading from OpenStreetMap way 201065097 and USDA Oct. 2023 photography, with the bow toward the shore and approximately 39.47 m extreme length.
lodDetails: Four levels preserve the curved red hull, stepped deckhouses and twin yellow light masts.
limitations: Exterior only. Restored appearance follows the clear museum-era reference views. Temporary deck-restoration covers and neighboring ships are omitted.
Riveting, rigging and fittings are simplified by distance. Submerged hull shape is interpretive from the original lines plan and capped below the normal waterline.
The mooring is fixed. Actual lake level and temporary vessel moves vary.
